name: High-bar squat
setup: Set rack, stance, and whole-foot support.
rom: Use a repeatable depth marker appropriate to the task.
observe: Foot support, knee path, torso behavior, and end-set depth.
profile: Vertical bar weight; joint moments require geometry and other forces.

name: Low-bar squat
setup: Establish a comfortable grip and stable bar support.
rom: Log the chosen depth and stance.
observe: Balance and reproducible torso inclination.
profile: Different bar position can change linked-segment geometry; no isolation claim.

name: Hack squat
setup: Set stops and platform position before loading.
rom: Record sled travel and joint-position landmarks.
observe: Support contact, foot pressure, controlled reversals.
profile: Machine path and mass conventions needed; stack label is insufficient.

name: Leg press
setup: Record seat setting, platform, and stops.
rom: End before losing the chosen pelvic/support relationship.
observe: Pelvic motion and repeatability; avoid diagnosing from one frame.
profile: Rail angle, friction, moving mass, and mechanism change force.

name: Knee extension
setup: Adjust axis region and pad to apparatus instructions.
rom: State knee start/end positions and reversal control.
observe: Hip position and pad contact throughout the set.
profile: Cam and pad leverage can vary; rectus femoris also crosses hip.

name: Conventional deadlift
secondary_position: Narrower stance with arms outside legs
setup: Arrange load over the intended base and take a repeatable grip.
rom: Floor start to controlled standing endpoint.
observe: Bar path, coordinated hip/knee extension, task consistency.
profile: Bar weight is only one external force component.

name: Sumo deadlift
secondary_position: Wider stance with arms inside legs
setup: Choose a reproducible stance and grip.
rom: Record floor start and completion rule.
observe: Foot support and coordinated extension.
profile: Different segment geometry from conventional; not universally safer.

name: Romanian deadlift
setup: Start standing; move hips back with load controlled near legs.
rom: Stop at reproducible hip-motion endpoint, not compulsory floor contact.
observe: Unplanned knee changes or new torso motion near bottom.
profile: External hip moment depends partly on horizontal bar-to-hip distance.

name: Barbell hip thrust
setup: Secure bench/support and load placement.
rom: Define bottom and top hip positions without chasing trunk extension.
observe: Support stability and actual hip motion.
profile: Support and load geometry differ from RDL; not a knee-flexion task.

name: Seated leg curl
secondary_position: Hip flexed relative to prone setup
setup: Record seat, thigh restraint, and pad adjustments.
rom: State knee arc and keep chosen pelvic position repeatable.
observe: Pelvis movement and reduced late-set arc.
profile: Machine-specific profile; hip position affects biarticular hamstring length.

name: Prone leg curl
secondary_position: Less hip flexion than seated setup
setup: Adjust pad and support to machine instructions.
rom: Record knee start/end landmarks.
observe: Pelvic lifting or unintended hip-motion changes.
profile: Knee-flexion task preserved; hip position differs from seated curl.

name: Barbell bench press
setup: Set rack/safeties or assistance, grip, and contact points.
rom: Record touch/depth and completion landmarks.
observe: Bar control, forearm arrangement, repeatable bottom.
profile: Vertical bar force; shoulder/elbow moments require geometry.

name: Dumbbell bench press
setup: Define per-dumbbell mass and controlled entry/exit.
rom: State depth and hand-path landmarks.
observe: Independent implement control and chosen shoulder motion.
profile: Gravity force direction; not identical to cable or barbell profile.

name: Incline dumbbell press
setup: Record bench angle convention and per-implement load.
rom: Use repeatable bottom and top positions.
observe: Arm path and torso/support contact.
profile: Incline changes relationship to gravity; no exact regional-growth promise.

name: Dip
secondary_position: Supported by hands with body moving
setup: Use suitable bars or assistance and a controllable starting position.
rom: Choose tolerable shoulder/elbow range with clear endpoint.
observe: Control, support, and changes in depth or swing.
profile: Body mass/assistance conventions differ from stack loading.

name: Cable fly
secondary_position: Elbow bend and shoulder range recorded
setup: Record pulley height, stance, and handle path.
rom: Define shoulder start/end positions rather than hand contact alone.
observe: Elbow bend drift and torso assistance.
profile: Cable points toward pulley; name does not establish stretch loading.

name: Dumbbell overhead press
secondary_position: Arm elevation with scapular upward rotation
setup: Select seated or standing setup and log it.
rom: Record chosen shoulder/elbow range.
observe: Torso behavior, implement path, and controlled arm elevation.
profile: Gravity-driven implement forces; bench scapular cue does not transfer automatically.

name: Cable lateral raise
secondary_position: Starting arm and pulley location defined
setup: Log anchor height and body position relative to pulley.
rom: Set start/end arm landmarks.
observe: Torso lean and changes in force-line geometry.
profile: Constant tension is not constant shoulder moment.

name: Lat pulldown
setup: Specify handle, grip reference, and torso setup.
rom: Record overhead and bottom landmarks.
observe: Elbow path, scapular motion, and changing torso swing.
profile: Actual pulley/handle force line needed; grip does not isolate a lat region.

name: Chest-supported close-elbow row
setup: Record bench angle and handle/implement arrangement.
rom: Define reach and end position.
observe: Shoulder-extension component, support contact, elbow path.
profile: Support reduces torso-holding demand; geometry still determines moments.

name: Chest-supported outward-elbow row
setup: Record bench and grip setup.
rom: Define arm/scapular landmarks without forcing a fixed maximum.
observe: Horizontal-abduction component and actual elbow path.
profile: Intended upper-back/rear-deltoid emphasis is not muscle isolation.

name: Pull-up
secondary_position: Body moves relative to fixed hand support
setup: Log grip, body mass, assistance, and added load conventions.
rom: Specify bottom/top landmarks.
observe: Body swing and reproducible shoulder/elbow movement.
profile: Body mass cannot be equated directly to pulldown stack mass.

name: Reverse fly
secondary_position: Chest support optional but must be specified
setup: Choose a controllable elbow bend and support arrangement.
rom: Define arm arc and endpoint.
observe: Actual shoulder motion versus torso motion.
profile: Different primary task from a vertical pull; gravity and leverage matter.

name: Overhead cable triceps extension
setup: Record pulley, arm position, grip, and support.
rom: State elbow arc with shoulder position repeatable.
observe: Upper-arm drift and force direction.
profile: Long-head position differs from pressdown; cable profile is setup-dependent.

name: Overhead dumbbell triceps extension
setup: Specify one/two hands and per-implement load.
rom: Choose repeatable elbow endpoints.
observe: Control and ability to maintain intended arm position.
profile: Preserves broad overhead position but not exact cable resistance profile.

name: Cable pressdown
setup: Record pulley/handle and torso setup.
rom: Specify elbow start/end positions.
observe: Upper-arm and trunk drift.
profile: Shares elbow extension with overhead version but changes shoulder position.

name: Incline dumbbell curl
secondary_position: Upper arm behind torso as set up
setup: Record bench angle, arm position, and per-dumbbell mass.
rom: Define elbow range without losing intended shoulder arrangement.
observe: Shoulder drift and controlled reversal.
profile: Gravity differs from cable force; behind-body label does not prove same profile.

name: Behind-body cable curl
secondary_position: Upper arm behind torso as set up
setup: Record pulley, stance, and shoulder position.
rom: Define elbow arc and upper-arm behavior.
observe: Cable line at start/middle/end.
profile: Same arm position can have different external moments with a new pulley line.

name: Standing calf raise
setup: Set support, foot position, and load convention.
rom: Record dorsiflexion and plantarflexion endpoints.
observe: Knee position and controlled reversal without undefined bounce.
profile: Longer gastrocnemius across knee than seated posture; soleus differs anatomically.

name: Seated calf raise
setup: Record knee/pad setup and foot position.
rom: Record ankle arc.
observe: Knee/pad movement and actual ankle travel.
profile: Changes gastrocnemius operating length; does not switch it completely off.

name: Cable crunch
setup: Select anchor, grip, and stance/support.
rom: Specify intended trunk-flexion arc.
observe: Distinguish trunk flexion from predominantly hip hinging.
profile: Cable kilograms alone do not identify abdominal or spinal tissue force.
